import concurrent.futures,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time,traceback,urllib.request
R=pathlib.Path('/workspace');os.chdir(R);D=R/'diagnostics';T=R/'tmp';T.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
deadline=json.loads((D/'preflight-start.json').read_text())['deadline_epoch']
report={'deadline_epoch':deadline,'commands':[],'chord_timing_audited':False,'inherited_native_exception_available':False}
def remaining():
 r=deadline-time.time()
 if r<=0:raise TimeoutError('180-second single-image preflight deadline exhausted')
 return r
def command(args):
 remaining();report['commands'].append(args)
 p=subprocess.run(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=remaining())
 return {'returncode':p.returncode,'output':p.stdout}
def download(item):
 url,path=item
 with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=min(20,remaining())) as response,path.open('wb') as out:
  while True:
   remaining();block=response.read(1024*1024)
   if not block:break
   out.write(block)
 return str(path)
try:
 remaining()
 assets=[('https://cdn.azul.com/zulu/bin/zulu25.38.107-ca-jre25.0.5-linux_aarch64.tar.gz',T/'java.tar.gz'),('https://github.com/Audiveris/audiveris/releases/download/5.11.0/Audiveris-5.11.0-ubuntu22.04-x86_64.deb',T/'audiveris.deb')]
 report['asset_urls']=[u for u,p in assets]
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
  futures=[pool.submit(download,item) for item in assets]
  results=[]
  for f in futures:
   try:results.append({'download':f.result(timeout=remaining())})
   except Exception:results.append({'exception':traceback.format_exc()})
 report['downloads']=results
 if any('exception' in x for x in results):raise RuntimeError('Runtime/application restoration failed; see exact download exceptions')
 (T/'java25').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 report['extract_java']=command(['tar','xzf',str(T/'java.tar.gz'),'-C',str(T/'java25')])
 report['extract_application']=command(['dpkg-deb','-x',str(T/'audiveris.deb'),str(T/'audiveris-root')])
 java=next((T/'java25').glob('*/bin/java'))
 report['java_version']=command([str(java),'-version'])
 for directory in ['native','javacpp','home']:(T/directory).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 cmd=json.loads((D/'recognition-command.json').read_text());cmd[0]=str(java)
 cmd=cmd[:cmd.index('--')+1]+[str(R/'inputs/sample-001.png')]
 cmd[cmd.index('-output')+1]=str(R/'recognition-preflight')
 report['pilot_input']='Original pilot image; enlarged derivative not inherited'
 (D/'preflight-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2))
 report['pilot_run']=command(cmd)
 (D/'preflight-recognition.log').write_text(report['pilot_run']['output'])
 exports=list((R/'recognition-preflight').rglob('*.mxl'))+list((R/'recognition-preflight').rglob('*.musicxml'))
 report['exports']=[str(p) for p in exports]
 report['milestone']='export requires content inspection' if exports else 'failed: no MusicXML export'
except Exception:
 report['exception']=traceback.format_exc();report['milestone']='failed: no verified single-image MusicXML export'
finally:
 report['finished_epoch']=time.time();report['elapsed_since_preflight_start']=time.time()-(deadline-180)
 (D/'bounded-preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
 print(json.dumps(report,indent=2)[-14000:])
